nonRouterAudit.scope: Concrete non-router detail/page destinations reached by NavigationLink or navigationDestination, plus top-level sheet/fullScreenCover screen presentations. AppTab/deep-router destinations remain governed by NavigationConfig and IOSContentRouter. Transient create/edit/action forms, Help presentation infrastructure, and camera/system pickers are recorded as explicit exemptions rather than independent AI pages.

destinations.rationale: Row and context-menu links reach the same inherited Vehicle Detail screen.
Tool Registry reaches the inherited Tool Detail screen.
Tool Admin reaches the same inherited Tool Detail screen.
Customers reaches the inherited Customer Detail screen.
Trailers reaches the same inherited detail by row navigation and context-menu sheet.
My Truck reaches the same inherited trailer detail by navigation and sheet.
Contractors reaches the inherited Contractor Detail screen.
Contacts resolves its typed navigation destination to Contact Detail.
Teams resolves its typed navigation destination to Team Detail.
Employees reaches the previously inventoried inherited Employee Detail screen.
Hat membership reaches the same inherited Employee Detail screen.
The all-notebooks list reaches the inherited Notebook Detail screen.
The job-notebooks list reaches the same inherited Notebook Detail screen.
Channels reaches the inherited Message Thread screen.
Job Detail reaches the same inherited Message Thread screen.
Dashboard category KPI navigation reaches a nested read-only detail.
Dashboard location KPI navigation reaches a nested read-only detail.
Dashboard job KPI navigation reaches a nested read-only detail.
Dashboard purchase-order KPI navigation reaches a nested read-only detail.
Dashboard low-stock KPI navigation reaches a nested read-only detail.
Startup error reporting is an unauthenticated recovery workflow, not an AI page-context destination.
Bug reporting is a transient assistant workflow and intentionally retains the assistant context.
Conflict review is a transient root workflow and intentionally retains the current containing-page context.
Tab editing is navigation-shell configuration, not a business page context.
The user menu is navigation-shell presentation and intentionally retains the underlying page context.
CameraCapture is a transient system capture surface without Help or independent AI context.
